Class MoleculeCamera

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.MoleculeCamera
public final class MoleculeCamera extends Object
Manages recipe viewport camera rotation, zooming, panning, and frame tracking states.

A recipe viewport camera; ordinary tooltips, HUDs and media exports keep their own orientation.

    • animationTime

      public long animationTime(long now)
      Continuous particle time that follows this camera's pause state. Resuming removes the paused interval, so electrons continue from their displayed positions instead of jumping to wall-clock time.
      Parameters:
      now - monotonic timestamp in nanoseconds
      Returns:
      animation timestamp with paused intervals removed
